metadata.dataset: Road walk: on-road line (western T07 segments + Arrowhead road pieces), speed badges (T07), HIN crash markers (Otter Tail SAP)
metadata.gap_note: T07 covers the western road walk only. No crash analysis and no verified per-segment speeds exist in the packet for the ITM or Arrowhead road walk, so the Arrowhead pieces carry the line only. Shoulders: no as-built shoulder width is published for any western segment (MnDOT TCDS omits shoulder widths), so the layer carries the T07 edge-condition note per segment (shoulder_quality) and no numeric shoulder_width_ft for any segment; the Arrowhead pieces carry no shoulder fields at all. Observed speeds: none published per segment - MnDOT's Speed Monitoring Program reports average 85th percentile speed aggregated by roadway category only, with no published station list; speed studies exist for CSAH 1, 4, 41, 60 and 88 (Otter Tail Board minutes, Jan 3, 2023) but only their recommendations are public, not the measured 85th percentile speeds.

properties.extent: North of Fergus Falls, south of 175th Ave to south of 180th Ave
properties.note: Highest county-highway traffic on the western route (678-5,259 AADT).
properties.caveat: Otter Tail County 2020-2024: 17 pedestrian crashes (1 fatal/serious, 16 non-severe) and 2 bicycle crashes on the county highway system. No published record attributes any crash to a hiker, and no hiker fatality or injury on the western road walk is documented. Wilkin/Becker segment-level pedestrian/bicycle counts could not be resolved from public sources (T07 Leg 3).
properties.position_note: Corridor extent per the SAP; marker at the segment midpoint, approximate within ~1 mi
properties.source: T07 Leg 3 (Otter Tail County Safety Action Plan, adopted May 26, 2026, pp. 60-64, Table 10)
